info.title: gojellyfin API
info.description: Operations gojellyfin serves that the Jellyfin API has no vocabulary for.

get.summary: Lists every configured Sonarr and Radarr instance.

post.summary: Adds a Sonarr or Radarr instance.

400.description: The source was refused, and why.
The source was refused, and why.

delete.summary: Removes one source, along with every file it reported.

post.summary: Tests a Sonarr or Radarr instance and lists its root folders.

get.summary: Lists the SOURCE_API_KEY_ variables set on this server, by name only.
Lists every title somebody asked for, with who asked and what each downloader answered.

post.summary: Approves one request and asks the downloaders for its title, again if they refused it before.

400.description: No downloader takes requests for this kind of title.

get.summary: Lists what each user may ask for.

put.summary: Replaces what one user may ask for.

get.summary: Lists every report of a broken title, newest first.

post.summary: Reports something wrong with a title.

400.description: The report was refused, and why.

post.summary: Marks one report as dealt with.
Marks one report as not worth acting on.
Deletes the reported file on its downloader, blocklists the release it came from and searches for another.

204.description: The downloader was asked for another copy, and the title's open reports are resolved.

400.description: The file could not be replaced, and why.

get.summary: Lists every environment variable this server reads and what it is set to, with secrets withheld.
Lists every shelf and whether it is on.
Says whether each part of the server is working, and what the library holds.

200.description: The checks and the library counts.

get.summary: Lists what the signed-in user asked for, newest first, with where each request stands.
Lists every live channel and what it airs.

400.description: The channel cannot air as described.

put.summary: Replaces a live channel's number, name, order and titles, keeping its schedule's seed.

400.description: The channel cannot air as described.

get.summary: Reads the playback override: the title that plays in place of whatever a user plays.

Url.description: Base address of the instance, without a trailing slash.

ApiKeyVariable.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key. Must begin with SOURCE_API_KEY_.

Url.description: Base address of the instance, without a trailing slash.

ApiKeyVariable.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key. Must begin with SOURCE_API_KEY_.

Paths.description: Where each folder the instance reports is opened on this server.

LastError.description: Why the instance last failed to answer, empty once it does.

Files.description: How many files the instance reported, across every root folder.

SourceWebhook.description: The webhook the instance calls when it imports, upgrades, renames or deletes a file. It is registered on the instance whenever the source is saved; the fields are what to type into Settings, Connect, Webhook by hand when it could not be.

Url.description: Where the instance posts, empty while PUBLISHED_SERVER_URL is not set.

RegisteredAt.description: When the instance last accepted the webhook.

Error.description: Why the instance last refused it, empty once it accepts.

RemotePath.description: A folder the instance reports its files under.

LocalPath.description: Where this server opens that folder.

SourceRequests.description: Where a title somebody asks for is added on the instance. Absent means the instance takes no requests.

QualityProfileId.description: The instance's own id for the quality profile a requested title is given.

RootFolder.description: The folder on the instance a requested title is added under.

Tag.description: A tag the instance puts on a requested title, so a library that filters on it shows what arrives.

ItemId.description: The id the title is opened by while the library lacks it.

AcceptedAt.description: When the instance took the title. Absent while it has refused.

Error.description: What the instance said the last time it refused.

Used.description: How many titles the user asked for in the last seven days.

NeedsApproval.description: Whether an administrator approves each request before a downloader is asked.

Quota.description: The most titles the user may ask for in seven days. Absent means no limit.

ItemName.description: The title, with its series and numbers when it is an episode.

Kind.description: Unplayable, Video, Audio, Subtitles or Other.

UserName.description: Who reported it. Absent when the server did.

Path.description: The file the report names, when it names one.

Replaceable.description: Whether a downloader names a file for the title, so another copy can be asked for.

Kind.description: Unplayable, Video, Audio, Subtitles or Other.

Value.description: What it is set to. Always empty for a secret.

Set.description: Whether the variable holds a value.

Enabled.description: The slugs of the shelves that are on.

HealthStatus.description: Ok works, Warn works with something to look at, Bad does not work, Off is not configured.

Detail.description: What was found, or what to set.

At.description: When what Detail describes happened, for a downloader the last time it answered.

Unprobed.description: Files ffprobe has not read since they last changed.

Unidentified.description: Titles with no provider ids or no artwork yet.

RefreshedAt.description: When a downloader was last read successfully.

UserName.description: The account signed in on the client, as it was named then.

Client.description: The app, as it names itself.

Build.description: The gojellyfin build that served it.

Direct.description: The file was sent as it is.

VideoDirect.description: The picture was copied rather than encoded.

AudioDirect.description: The sound was copied rather than converted.

Reasons.description: The TranscodeReasons the plan recorded for this file.

StartTicks.description: Where in the file the stream started.

ReportAttempt.description: The client, the account and how the file was being served when the report was filed. Absent for a probe's report and for reports filed before this was recorded. The serving fields are absent for a report filed from a client rather than by a stream.

ItemId.description: The id the title is opened by, which answers the library's own item once it holds the title.

State.description: Pending while it waits for an administrator, Declined, Requested once approved and asked of a downloader, Ready once the library holds it.

LiveChannelOrder.description: Shuffle reshuffles the titles on every pass; Sequential airs them in the order listed, a series by season and episode; Interleave takes turns between the titles listed, each series by season and episode, spread so a short series is not over before a long one has begun.

ItemIds.description: Movies, series, seasons or episodes, in the order a sequential channel airs them.
Movies, series, seasons or episodes, in the order a sequential channel airs them.

Enabled.description: Whether the override is on. Turning it off stops it at once.

ItemId.description: The movie or episode that plays instead.

From.description: When it starts; none means as soon as it is on.

Until.description: When it ends; none means until it is turned off.

UserIds.description: Who it applies to; empty means every user who is not an administrator.
